configuration.client_baseline: separate reference histogram for each Phase 3 simulated client
configuration.binning: 10 empirical quantile bins per client/feature; duplicate quantile cut-points collapse; effective bin count may be lower
configuration.empty_bins: floor each bin proportion at epsilon=1e-06, then renormalize before logarithm
configuration.threshold_rationale: Predeclared PSI 0.25 operational heuristic for a material distribution shift; not fitted or tuned on validation/test, and not a statistical guarantee.
configuration.alert_rule: window alert if any feature PSI is greater than or equal to threshold; window score is maximum feature PSI
configuration.no_drift_stream: independent rows from the same simulated client's training partition, disjoint from its reference rows

synthetic_shift.source: training rows copied and modified in memory; not natural traffic drift

memory_strategy: training arrays memory-mapped; reference/windows gathered in bounded row batches; one client reference and one current window held per scoring operation
interpretation: A PSI alert indicates feature-distribution change only; it is not evidence or confirmation of a cyberattack.
runtime_scope: after prepared arrays are mapped and Phase 3 client partitions are regenerated/verified; includes reference fitting, stream scoring, and artifact writes, but excludes process startup and input/partition loading
